description: Wire the tuner into CONTINUOUS on-PC orchestration (PowerShell/BAT), preserve report history per-iteration, update .gitignore reasoning, write the tuner README, and append the Round 3 entry to ITERATION_LOG.md. Depends on FEAT-002 (the tuner package + CLI must exist). This feature is authored/read-through only in-sandbox (PowerShell and the live loop cannot run here).
steps: Create the continuous orchestration. Prefer a NEW automation/run_tuner_loop.ps1 (plus automation/run_tuner_loop.bat wrapper) that duplicates the proven structure of automation/run_backtest_loop.ps1 (reuse the same $Config block shape, Write-Log, Fail, Invoke-AndWait, Invoke-Git, Write-NewestTesterLogTail helpers - copy them or dot-source; keep ASCII-only and no secrets) but wraps the round body in a `while ($true)` outer loop with NO Start-Sleep gap between iterations. Each iteration, in order: (a) git pull --ff-only; (b) BEFORE compile, the tuner's proposed params are ALREADY written into GaganEA.mq5 by the previous iteration's tuner call (on the very first iteration, params are the current committed defaults) - copy GaganEA.mq5 into MQL5\Experts; (c) headless compile with compile-log parsing (reuse existing logic; on compile failure, log and `continue` to next iteration rather than killing the loop, since the tuner could in principle propose a bad edit - but note params.py already guarantees validity); (d) fill a per-iteration tester .ini from backtest_template.ini and run terminal64.exe headless with ShutdownTerminal=1 and the existing timeout; (e) locate the report and copy it to reports/tuner/iterNNNN.html (zero-padded iteration index from tuner_state.json, or a timestamp) instead of the fixed round01 name so history is preserved; (f) run tools/analyze_report.py on it to produce the .summary.json alongside; (g) invoke the tuner: python3 automation/tuner/tuner.py --summary-json reports/tuner/iterNNNN.summary.json (plus --mq5 and --state paths) so it ingests THIS result, updates state/best, and writes the NEXT params into GaganEA.mq5; (h) git add/commit/push this iteration's report + reports/tuner/*.summary.json + automation/tuner/tuner_state.json + GaganEA.mq5 (reuse Invoke-Git and the exit-code checks; skip cleanly if nothing changed); then loop immediately. Handle per-step failures without killing the whole loop where sensible (log a WARN/ERROR and `continue`); only a fatal config error should exit.

Iteration indexing: read the iteration counter from automation/tuner/tuner_state.json so report names and the loop stay in sync across restarts (restart-safe). Decide and document whether the loop increments before or after the tuner call; keep it consistent so iterNNNN.html maps to the params that produced it.

Report history retention policy: name full reports reports/tuner/iterNNNN.html (or timestamped) and ALWAYS keep every .summary.json (small). To avoid committing unbounded huge HTML files, keep only the latest N full HTMLs (e.g. N=20) - prune older reports/tuner/iter*.html beyond N in the loop (git rm the pruned ones) while keeping ALL summary JSONs. Document this choice in the README and in .gitignore comments. Implement the pruning in the PowerShell loop (ASCII-only) OR document it clearly if left manual.

Update .gitignore: ensure reports/tuner/*.summary.json are tracked (add a negation like !reports/tuner/*.summary.json consistent with the existing reports/*.summary.json ignore + !reports/round*.summary.json pattern) and that automation/tuner/tuner_state.json is TRACKED (not ignored) while the tuner's per-iteration LOG files live under an ignored logs dir (e.g. automation/tuner/logs/ ignored, matching automation/logs/). Keep the negations AFTER the ignore rules (existing convention). Verify with `git check-ignore -v` reasoning in comments; keep committed artifacts sensible.

Write automation/tuner/README.md (concise, pure ASCII, no em dashes): what the tuner does; the AUTHORITATIVE scoring rule (maximize net profit subject to a HARD 15% relative-drawdown ceiling; DD>15% always ranks below DD<=15%; net profit then PF tiebreaker; <30-trade penalty); the tunable parameter space with bounds; how to START the continuous loop (the .bat), how to STOP it (close the window / Ctrl+C / end the scheduled task), how to read tuner_state.json and the per-iteration logs, how to RESET (tuner.py --reset), and PROMINENT honest caveats: (i) it optimizes NUMBERS not strategy logic and CANNOT manufacture a positive edge if none exists (v2.11 PF is 0.58 < 1); (ii) continuous tuning on the shortened ~1-month window WILL overfit - mandate/recommend periodic validation on the FULL 6-month window (FromDate=2026.03.01) before trusting any 'best'; (iii) it is a LOCAL optimizer. Also cross-link SETUP.md and note the STRONG recommendation to run ONE manual tuner iteration first (a single backtest + one tuner.py invocation) before starting the infinite loop.

Append a Round 3 entry to ITERATION_LOG.md following the existing per-round template: Hypothesis (a rule-based auto-tuner can minimize loss and hold DD <= 15% by grinding numeric params, but cannot by itself create a positive edge - PF must be fixed structurally); Change made (added automation/tuner/ Python auto-tuner + continuous orchestration + report-history change + tests; describe the MECHANISM: score -> local search + rule nudges -> rewrite mq5 inputs -> recompile/backtest -> repeat); Backtest config (XAUUSD, tester M1/EA M5, note the ~1-month fast window with the 6-month validation caveat); Key metrics = pending next backtest (NO invented numbers); Diagnosis = pending; Next step; Report file = reports/tuner/iterNNNN.html going forward. Honest limits stated. Do not fabricate performance.

Read-through verification of all PowerShell/BAT: confirm brace/paren/bracket balance, pure ASCII (grep -nP '[^\x00-\x7F]'), no secrets, and that the existing safeguards (compile-log parsing, report detection, Invoke-Git exit-code checks, ShutdownTerminal, timeout) are preserved in the continuous variant. Explicitly note in the response that PowerShell/BAT and the live continuous loop are NOT executable in-sandbox and are read-through-only.
acceptance_criteria: A continuous orchestration script exists (automation/run_tuner_loop.ps1 + .bat) that loops back-to-back with no Start-Sleep gap, calls the tuner each cycle at the correct point, and commits the report + summary JSON + tuner_state.json + GaganEA.mq5 each iteration.
Reports are written per-iteration (reports/tuner/iterNNNN.html) so history is not overwritten; every .summary.json is kept and a documented retention cap bounds full HTMLs.
.gitignore tracks tuner_state.json and reports/tuner/*.summary.json (via negations after the ignore rules) and ignores the tuner logs dir; reasoning documented.

automation/tuner/README.md documents the scoring rule, tunable space, start/stop/reset/read-state, and the three prominent honest caveats (numbers-not-logic, overfitting/6-month validation, local optimizer), plus the run-one-manual-iteration-first recommendation.
ITERATION_LOG.md has a Round 3 entry describing the tuner (hypothesis + mechanism + honest limits) with NO invented performance numbers.
All touched Python is pure ASCII; PowerShell/BAT are pure ASCII with balanced braces/parens/brackets and no secrets; existing safeguards preserved.
The response clearly states that PowerShell/BAT and the live continuous loop are read-through-only (unverifiable in-sandbox).
verification: python3 -m py_compile on any Python touched here exits 0; python3 -m unittest for tuner tests and the existing analyzer suite still pass.
grep -nP '[^\x00-\x7F]' over automation/run_tuner_loop.ps1, automation/run_tuner_loop.bat, automation/tuner/README.md and all touched files returns nothing.

Manual brace/paren/bracket balance check of the new .ps1 (count/inspect) and a read-through confirming the while-loop wiring, tuner call placement, per-iteration report naming, and git commit of state+mq5.
git check-ignore reasoning confirms tuner_state.json is tracked and reports/tuner/*.summary.json is tracked while the logs dir is ignored.

Hypothesis = auto-tuner controls DD<=15% and minimizes loss but cannot create a positive edge (PF must be fixed structurally). Change made describes the tuner package + continuous orchestration + report-history change + tests and the mechanism. Key metrics + Diagnosis = pending next backtest (NO invented numbers). Report file = reports/tuner/iterNNNN.html. Matched the file's existing em-dash style; did NOT de-ASCII pre-existing markdown and preferred ASCII in the new prose.
findings.iteration_indexing_decision: The report index = tuner_state.json 'iteration' counter (read at the TOP of each cycle) + 1. Rationale: state.record_iteration bumps 'iteration' to N+1 when the tuner INGESTS this cycle's result, so naming the report iter(N+1) makes reports/tuner/iterNNNN.html map 1:1 to the tuner history record with iteration=NNNN and to the params that produced it (the params written by the previous cycle / committed defaults on cycle 1). Restart-safe because the counter is read from the tracked state file, not an in-memory variable; first-ever run (no state file) -> counter 0 -> iter0001. Zero-padded %D4 (iter0001).
findings.loop_wiring: while($true) with a per-cycle try/catch that logs-and-continues on any unexpected error (only a fatal config check before the loop calls Fail/exit). Per cycle in order: (a) git checkout+pull --ff-only (checkout failure -> continue; pull non-zero -> WARN continue-with-local); (b) copy GaganEA.mq5 into MQL5\Experts; (c) headless compile + compile-log parsing (anchored '(line,col) : error' regex + 'N error' count; on failure log ERROR and continue, NOT Fail); (d) fill per-iteration runtime .ini from backtest_template.ini (__EXPERT_PATH__ -> ExpertName, __REPORT_NAME__ -> IterTag), run terminal64 headless with ShutdownTerminal=1 + TesterTimeoutSec; (e) locate report (primary .htm/.html candidates under MT5DataDir + legacy ..\..\ + recursive Depth-3 search with fresh/stale runStart checks) and copy to reports/tuner/iterNNNN.html; (f) run tools\analyze_report.py to produce iterNNNN.summary.json (non-zero -> continue); (g) invoke python automation\tuner\tuner.py --summary-json <iter summary> --state <tuner_state.json> --mq5 <repo GaganEA.mq5> (non-zero -> WARN, still commits the report); (h) prune; (i) git add/commit/push. Loops immediately, no sleep.
findings.retention_policy: reports/tuner/iterNNNN.html named per-iteration so history is not overwritten. Every iterNNNN.summary.json is kept forever (tiny). Full HTMLs: only the newest TunerHtmlKeep (default 20) are kept; older ones are pruned each cycle via 'git rm -q --ignore-unmatch' (falls back to Remove-Item if the file was never tracked). Sort by Name descending (iter#### zero-padding makes lexical order == numeric order). Documented in README and in a .gitignore comment.

Scratch files/dirs removed after the check.
findings.commit_set: Per cycle stages by name (no git add -A): reports/tuner/<IterTag>.html, reports/tuner/<IterTag>.summary.json, automation/tuner/tuner_state.json, automation/tuner/current_params.json, GaganEA.mq5, plus any HTML git-rm'd by the pruner. Each add checks its exit code; if nothing staged, commit/push is skipped cleanly. Commit message: 'Tuner iterNNNN: backtest report + next params'.

review_fixes_2026-09-13-131052.issue2_index_reuse_on_tuner_failure: FIXED in automation/run_tuner_loop.ps1. Root cause: the state counter is bumped only when the tuner ingests successfully (state.save runs after a successful rewrite), so a cycle that committed reports/tuner/iterNNNN.html+summary but then had the tuner exit non-zero left the counter at N; the next cycle recomputed the same iter(N+1) and overwrote the committed artifact. Fix: after the tuner call, on $tunerCode -ne 0 the loop renames this cycle's report AND its .summary.json to reports/tuner/iterNNNN_notuned_<IterStamp>.{html,summary.json} (Move-Item -Force, wrapped in try/catch so a rename failure is non-fatal and falls back to the original name with a WARN) and commits under that distinct name via new $CommitHtmlRel/$CommitSummaryRel/$CommitReport/$CommitSummary variables that the $addTargets list and the cycle-done log now use. On the success path these equal the plain iterNNNN name (behavior unchanged). Restart-safe (rename is derived from the same $IterTag + $IterStamp already computed at cycle top). Header comment (step g) and README 'Iteration indexing and report history' updated to document the _notuned suffix. Pruner (step h) still matches iter*.html so _notuned reports participate in the newest-N retention normally.
